Faiyaz Mohd. Sheikh And Ors. vs Union Of India Thru. Secy.
Ministry Food ... on 4 January, 2024 
Author: Vivek Chaudhary
Bench: Vivek Chaudhary
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Court No. - 2
Case :- Writ - C No. - 20119 of 2017
Petitioner :- Faiyaz Mohd. Sheikh And Ors.
Respondent :- Union Of India Thru. Secy. Ministry Food Safety And Standard
Counsel for Petitioner :- Syed Mohd. Arshad Rizvi,Dharmendra Singh 
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,A.K.Verma,A.S.G.
Hon'ble Vivek Chaudhary,J.
Hon'ble Om Prakash Shukla,J.
1.  Case is called out in the revised list.
2. No one is present on behalf of petitioners to press the writ petition. 
3. Learned Standing Counsel for the State is present. 
4. Hence, the writ petition is dismissed for want of prosecution. 
5. Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
